name: Prom Night Dress Up 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames

description: Prom Night Dress Up is a beauty game where you can experience the excitement of prom night with 6 stylish girl friends competing for the title of prom queen! Show off your fashion prowess in this makeover and dress-up game for girls, featuring over 200 trendy clothing items.
